howToOrder.title: How your order works
howToOrder.step1Text: Pick your piece, color and size, and add it to your bag.
howToOrder.step2Text: Fill in your details, delivery and payment method — your order reaches us on WhatsApp.
howToOrder.step3Text: We contact you to confirm, then deliver or you pick it up from the market.
